source.label: tab:final-human-audit-exclusions
source.caption: The nine nonapprovals in the final random audit. Q1, Q2 and Q3 check the source interpretation, witness and Lean statement. All nine are excluded from the current 147 dossiers and both benchmark subsets. "Earlier set" refers to the original 191 primary and 255 scorable inputs. Certificate versions are identified by SHA-256 prefixes; the linked version ledger gives full source, packet and certificate hashes. Concerns summarize the recorded reviews, not new adjudications.

rows.recorded_concern: Connection from the source's group construction to Lean is left to prose.
Zero witness conflicts with an implicit nonzero assumption.
Category-label mismatch is treated as a refutation under a disputed translation.
Lean supplies the size-one transition law rather than deriving it.
Boolean instance lacks formal syntax and substitution linking it to the source.
Humorous runtime claim is unspecified; Lean checks a supplied runtime function.
True equalities are displayed; the false step is implied rather than asserted.
Target is a typing requirement in the model setup, rather than an assertion.
Quoted supposition introduces a case; the gap is its later generalization.
